name: Sunray Freeport 3-Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna 300D1
description: Description The SunRay Freeport 3-Person Outdoor Traditional Sauna is built from Canadian hemlock wood for durability and features a shingled roof for outdoor protection. Its double-paneled wall construction provides excellent heat retention, while the front window and glass door allow natural light into the cabin. A 4.5 kW electric heater with lava rocks delivers steam heat up to 170°F. Additional features include chromatherapy mood lighting, Bluetooth speakers, a hygrometer, a sand timer, and a 55-inch wide bench seat for comfortable 3-person use.
